description: This file defines the main React component for the application's front end, managing document uploads, persona data, and orchestrating interactions with backend APIs for persona generation, updating, and finalization within a Next.js project.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array by filtering out non-string or empty elements.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for a display label, used in avatar chips.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely traverses a nested object based on a path array, returning both value and found path, useful for debugging orchestration response shape.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and nested 'artifacts' keys of an object for debugging payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the persona JSON object and its source path from an orchestration record, prioritizing actual persona payloads.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON structures into the component's internal PersonaData format, handling various legacy and current formats.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the UI state, interactions, and backend API communication for persona generation workflow.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles user file selection, validates, and updates the list of uploaded files.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop of files into upload area.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from uploaded files list based on its ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers the process to upload documents and request a draft persona from backend orchestration.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to backend as a new version.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, persisting it in backend as the official persona.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-triggers persona draft generation based on existing build.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from persona skills array.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona skills array.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles user uploading a new profile image and updates persona data.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a hash string to compare persona data for changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a hash string to compare artwork/artifact payloads from orchestration responses.
